entry.title: Heavy Snow Watch
entry.summary: Periods of heavy snow above 600 metres, where snowfall amounts may approach warning criteria, and lesser amount down to 400 metres. Chance of upgrading to a Warning: Moderate.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Heavy Rain Watch
entry.summary: Heavy rain is expected to spread north during Wednesday morning and afternoon, and amounts may approach warning criteria. Chance of upgrading to a Warning: Moderate.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Heavy Rain Watch
entry.summary: Heavy rain is expected to spread northwards from Tuesday evening. Rainfall accumulations may approach warning criteria. Chance of upgrading to a Warning: Moderate.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow lowering to 400m. Accumulations of 5 to 10cm are possible above 600m and lesser amounts down to 400m.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow is expected to lower to 500 metres Wednesday afternoon and evening. 3 to 5 cm may accumulate above 700 metres, with lesser amounts lower down.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow may affect the road from Wednesday morning until early evening. Up to 1 cm may accumulate at the tunnel entrance, with lesser amounts lower down.
